top_signals.title: DOGE said it saved $1.7 billion by terminating a military health IT contract. GAO found the contract was never terminated.
top_signals.summary: DOGE reported $1.76 billion in savings from terminating a contract, but GAO found that the contract was never terminated and no funds were deobligated.

top_signals.title: Cava Rises on Sales; CoreWeave Soars on AI Outlook | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Cava (CAVA) is also rising this morning as sales jumped with Americans flocking to Pita Chips, Salmon, and other Mediterranean-diet oriented foods.
- Super Micro (SMCI) is giving a sales outlook that topped even the rosiest projections. That along with Coreweave's report is sending markets higher.
- CoreWeave (CRWV) is soaring after booming AI demand bolstered the company's revenue outlook. Nebius (NBIS) is also up this morning with earnings coming out. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: BIP-110 failure shows Bitcoin would be ‘almost impossible to reproduce,’ Plan B Network director says
top_signals.summary: Plan B Network director Giacomo Zucco says BIP-110’s failure exposed the challenges of recreating Bitcoin’s early development.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 4 June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.
